author: xrs_01
content: Gm everybody. I've been working on a formal specification (https://docs.fileverse.io/document/36gVyMvnJL9VG6Redkxhgi#k=SSYA8TWI1tDHNg-aAwCcgvxY_u1ZPnxXC4rcmmEscNg) for my delegated execution sharding (DES) proposal that integrates with the existing Lean Consensus codebase in order to practically ground the proposal in the existing roadmap, while also creating the bedrock for some of the deeper analysis I'm doing into the tradeoffs and assumptions made by the different constructs I'm proposing.
